__comment: Snow / blizzard weather. See data/weather/clear.json for the full field reference.
height_fog seeded from Stonehearth's blizzard settings. POSITIVE snow_accumulation_per_minute
builds snow cover over time (WeatherManager clamps total 0..1); clear/foggy use a negative value
so cover melts. Snow is a winter-weighted weather in data/calendar/weather_schedule.json.
